Third Quarter Financial Highlights: • Revenue of $842.0 million, up 19.2%, or 19.6% in constant currency, slightly above the high end of the Company’s guidance range of 17.5% - 19.5% at constant currency rates ◦ Total Omnipod revenue of $836.6 million, rose 19.7%, or 20.0% in constant currency ▪ U.S. Omnipod revenue of $570.4 million, increased 14.7% ▪ International Omnipod revenue of $266.2 million, increased 31.7%, or 33.0% in constant currency ◦ Drug Delivery revenue of $5.5 million • Operating income of $189.8 million, or 22.5% of revenue, up 590 basis points over prior year • Adjusted operating income 1 of $185.2 million, or 22.0% of revenue, up 490 basis points compared to prior year • Net income of $141.1 million, or $2.03 per diluted share, compared to $87.6 million, or $1.24 per diluted share, in the prior year • Adjusted net income 1 of $138.0 million, increased 57.2% compared to $87.8 million in the prior year • Adjusted earnings 1 of $1.99 per diluted share, increased 59.9%, compared to $1.24 per diluted share, in the prior year Recent Strategic Highlights: • Advanced commercial objectives, completing U.S. sales force expansion and executing Type 2 action plan by improving onboarding and customer support, enhancing sampling, and aligning sales force compensation with new customer start and retention goals • Completed full U.S. market release of Omnipod Discover ® , driving adoption by more than 35,000 users and 5,000 healthcare professionals across available markets 2 , extending the reach of our proprietary engagement platform to deliver personalized insights and decision support to both people with diabetes and healthcare professionals strengthening engagement, improving outcomes, and increasing customer loyalty • Extended Omnipod 5 algorithm enhancement to full retail across the U.S., with real-world evidence showing better user outcomes with less effort • Extended Omnipod 5 Ecosystem with sensor choice by expanding Abbott’s FreeStyle Libre 3 Plus Continuous Glucose Monitor (CGM) integration across Belgium, Netherlands, UK, Italy, Finland, Norway, Sweden, Australia, Switzerland and Germany • Presented data at European Association for the Study of Diabetes (EASD) 2026, reinforcing our global clinical evidence 1 See description of non-GAAP financial measures contained in this release. 2 Omnipod Discover global users time-in-range (TIR) outcomes 3 ◦ EVOLUTION 3 fully closed-loop feasibility study demonstrated adults with type 2 diabetes using both a GLP-1 and CGM saw additional TIR benefit from fully closed-loop automated insulin delivery with no user initiated boluses 4 • Completed enrollment in two key clinical trials supporting our innovation pipeline: ◦ STRIVE2 type 1 diabetes cohort, marking an important milestone in the advancement of Omnipod 6 ◦ EVOLVE pivotal study, supporting the development of fully closed-loop automated insulin delivery (AID) for adults with type 2 diabetes Received approval from the Board of Directors for a $1 billion share repurchase program. The Company expects to allocate approximately $400 million toward repurchases in the fourth quarter of 2026, funded with existing cash. This expanded authorization reflects Insulet’s strong balance sheet and disciplined approach to capital deployment. “Our team delivered a strong quarter, with revenue growth of nearly 20% and significant margin expansion,” said Ashley McEvoy, President and CEO. “We are making continued progress on our type 2 action plan, strengthening our commercial capabilities, expanding our customer base, increasing manufacturing scale and advancing innovation. As we look ahead, the business is well positioned for durable, profitable growth. The share repurchase we are announcing today demonstrates our confidence in the strength of the Omnipod platform and Insulet's long-term trajectory.” 2026 Outlook: For the year ending December 31, 2026, the Company is providing the following guidance (revenue in constant currency): FY 2026 Guidance (as of 11/4/2026) FY 2026 Prior Guidance (as of 8/5/2026) U.S. Omnipod 17.5% - 18.5% 17% - 19% International Omnipod 32% - 33% 30% - 32% Total Omnipod 21.5% - 22.5% 21% - 23% Drug Delivery ~(40%) ~(40%) Total 21% - 22% 20% - 22% Adjusted Operating Margin 1 ~150 bps YoY expansion ~100 bps YoY expansion Adjusted EPS Growth 1 >30% >30% Conference Call: Insulet will host a conference call at 8:00 a.m. (Eastern Time) on November 4, 2026 to discuss the financial results and outlook. Safety and performance of a fully closed-loop (FCL) algorithm for Omnipod in people with type 2 diabetes using GLP-1 RA; sub-analysis of the EVOLUTION3 study presented at EASD 2026; October 1; Milan. 2 About Insulet Corporation: Insulet Corporation (NASDAQ: PODD), headquartered in Massachusetts, is an innovative medical device company dedicated to simplifying life for people with diabetes and other conditions through its Omnipod product platform. The Omnipod Insulin Management System provides a unique alternative to traditional insulin delivery methods. With its simple, wearable design, the tubeless disposable Pod provides up to three days of non-stop insulin delivery, without the need to see or handle a needle. Insulet’s flagship innovation, the Omnipod 5 Automated Insulin Delivery System, integrates with a continuous glucose monitor to manage blood sugar with no multiple daily injections, zero fingersticks, and can be controlled by a compatible personal smartphone in the U.S. or by the Omnipod 5 Controller. Insulet also leverages the unique design of its Pod by tailoring its Omnipod technology platform for the delivery of non-insulin subcutaneous drugs across other therapeutic areas. For more information, visit insulet.com or omnipod.com . Non-GAAP Measures: The Company uses the following non-GAAP financial measures: • Constant currency revenue growth, which represents the change in revenue between current and prior-year periods using the exchange rate in effect during the applicable prior-year period. Insulet presents constant currency revenue growth because management believes it provides meaningful information regarding the Company’s results on a consistent and comparable basis across periods. Management uses this non-GAAP financial measure, in addition to financial measures in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles in the United States (GAAP), to evaluate the Company’s operating results. It is also one of the performance metrics that determines management incentive compensation. • Adjusted gross profit, adjusted gross margin, adjusted operating income, adjusted operating margin, adjusted net income, and adjusted diluted earnings per share exclude the impact of certain significant transactions or events, such as legal settlements, gains (losses) on investments and loss on extinguishment of debt, that affect the period-to-period comparability of the Company’s performance, as applicable. • Adjusted EBITDA, which represents net income plus net interest expense (income), income tax expense (benefit), depreciation and amortization, stock-based compensation expense, and other significant transactions or events that affect the period-to-period comparability of the Company’s performance, as applicable, and adjusted EBITDA as a percentage of revenue. • Free cash flow, defined as net cash provided by operating activities less capital expenditures. Management uses this non-GAAP measure, in addition to GAAP financial measures, to evaluate our operating results. Insulet presents the above non-GAAP financial measures because management uses them as supplemental measures to assess the Company’s performance, and the Company believes they are helpful to investors and other interested parties in comparing the Company’s performance from period to period. 3 These non-GAAP financial measures should be considered supplemental to, and not a substitute for, the Company’s financial results prepared in accordance with GAAP. Furthermore, the Company’s definition of these non-GAAP measures may differ from similarly titled measures used by others. Because non-GAAP financial measures exclude the effect of items that will increase or decrease the Company’s reported results of operations, Insulet strongly encourages investors to review the Company’s consolidated financial statements and publicly filed reports in their entirety. our ability to maintain the privacy and security of Company and third-party information; our ability to attract, motivate, and retain key personnel; risks associated with potential future acquisitions or investments in new businesses;
